method.name: Horn 3x3 on true 3D positions of bilinearly sampled local gnomonic grid
method.scale_note: Source pixels about 59.2 m; resampled local 60 m grid; slope measured across about 120 m. Bilinear interpolation adds no measured detail.
method.exceedance: stored slope strictly greater than threshold
method.area_weighting: equal local sampling cells; gnomonic area variation negligible over 500 m
method.invalid: missing any neighbor: unknown, excluded; never flat
